security_audit.summary: The real security concern is that the skill instructs agents to run external npx commands, including commands with a user-supplied URL argument. The remaining static hits are markdown fences, workflow prose, or generated output path references. I found no prompt-injection attempt or malicious intent in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the extract-design-system package version and document that npx may download and run package code.

remediation.issue: User-provided URL passed to shell command
remediation.suggestion: Validate the URL, quote the argument, and require explicit confirmation before running commands that use it.
Ask before installing Chromium with Playwright and explain the local disk and network effects.

content.value_statement: Teams need a fast starting point when matching an existing public website. This skill extracts visible design primitives and generates local token files for review.
actual_capabilities: Runs extract-design-system against a public website URL when approved.
Installs Chromium with Playwright when the local browser dependency is missing.
Reviews normalized extraction output for colors, fonts, spacing, radius, and shadows.
Generates starter tokens.json and tokens.css files from extracted primitives.
Supports extraction-only mode and token regeneration from existing normalized output.
limitations: Does not build a complete component library.
Does not guarantee pixel-perfect reproduction of the source site.
Single-page or dynamic sites may not represent a full product design system.
Requires review before using extracted third-party styles in an application.

use_cases.title: Audit Public Brand Styling
use_cases.description: Extract visible colors, typography, and spacing from a public site to start a design-token discussion.

use_cases.title: Start Frontend Theme Files
use_cases.description: Generate starter token files before wiring CSS variables into an app.

use_cases.title: Document Design Primitives
use_cases.description: Review normalized output to document likely primitives before a deeper manual audit.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Basic Tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to extract design primitives from https://example.com. Generate starter token files and summarize the main colors and fonts.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Without Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill on https://example.com with extraction only. Do not create starter token files. Summarize the normalized output.

prompt_templates.title: Regenerate Token Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the existing .extract-design-system/normalized.json to regenerate starter token files. Review the generated CSS variables before suggesting app changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Adoption Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the extraction for https://example.com, review colors, fonts, spacing, radius, and shadows, then list what requires human validation before adoption.

output_examples.input: Extract design primitives from a public marketing site.
output: Primary color candidates identified with secondary and accent colors.
Detected font families and fallback behavior summarized.
Starter token files generated for review.

output_examples.input: Run extraction-only mode for a design audit.
output_examples.output: The result is a concise report of detected tokens, missing scales, and recommended manual review points.

output_examples.input: Regenerate starter files from normalized output.
output_examples.output: The skill refreshes the token file set and explains which generated files changed conceptually.

best_practices: Confirm the target URL is public and approved before running extraction.
Review normalized output before importing generated tokens into an application.
Ask for confirmation before changing existing app code, styles, or config files.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one page as a complete design system.
Do not overwrite existing styling without explicit user approval.
Do not infer semantic tokens or components that were not extracted.

faq.question: Does this create a full design system?
faq.answer: No. It creates starter token files from visible design primitives.

faq.question: Can it inspect private websites?
faq.answer: It is intended for public, reachable URLs. Private or authenticated sites need separate user approval and access handling.

faq.question: Which files can it generate?
faq.answer: It can produce raw extraction output, normalized data, tokens.json, and tokens.css.

faq.question: Does it modify my app automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the agent to ask before changing existing app code, styles, or configuration.

faq.question: Can I run analysis without starter files?
faq.answer: Yes. Use extraction-only mode when you only need the extracted design data.

faq.question: Why is manual review required?
faq.answer: Extraction can miss dynamic states, hidden pages, and brand rules, so humans must validate the result.
